data: KIT 157-ch axial gradiometers (MNE mag, T), 1000 Hz; 12 subjects x 11 trials (132), trial start = onset trigger 162; stimulus = broadband envelope summed from the authors' 1000 Hz gammatone spectrogram (no audio exists); ~5 ms feature lead (10 ms left-aligned window) not shifted
picks: good axial gradiometers (MEG 001-157 minus info['bads'], 150-155 per subject); no re-referencing

preprocessing.refreg: the 3 reference magnetometers (MEG 158-160) regressed out of every good gradiometer per trial (OLS over the whole trial, both 0.5 Hz high-passed zero-phase); validation only; Maxwell filtering does not apply to KIT

mlr_feature_note: the repo validator builds the hf feature only from audio (load.stimulus_feature returns None for an envelope, so `--tiers low,mlr` silently skips mlr); here the 1000 Hz envelope is used as the hf feature (patched stimulus_feature), the rest is repo code

tiers_not_run.brainstem: not attempted: no audio exists (copyright; only the authors' 1000 Hz gammatone spectrogram), so there is no half-wave-rectified waveform regressor; the envelope is a 10 ms boxcar average (first null at 100 Hz) and the triggers jitter by ~10 ms (trigger-interval states 7-10 ms apart), which would cancel 30-250 Hz responses; for MEG this tier would only test 30-250 Hz cortical timing at 28-45 ms

backward.method: LOTO ridge backward decoder over the subject's 11 trials, good gradiometers x lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1 x mean eigenvalue, 64 Hz, 0.5-8 Hz; nulls per held-out trial: 50 circular shifts (>= 5 s) and the 10 other trials' envelopes (mismatch, np.resize); subject null = 2000 draws of one null value per trial; population null = mean of subject nulls; lag sweep +-1 s in 15.6 ms steps (positive = stimulus delayed), parabolic peak, subject-bootstrap 95% CI; tolerance 1 sample (15.6 ms). NB the sweep is relative to decoders trained on the same subject's trials: a constant trigger-to-sound latency shifts training and test alike and cannot appear here; only trial-specific offsets can.

offsets_vs_trigger_interval.note: repo low-tier per-trial offset (forward model, 64 Hz, parabolic; relative to the subject's model trained on the other trials) minus the subject median, vs trigger-interval error (offset trigger - onset trigger - stimulus duration, ms). If the onset trigger carried the ~10 ms jitter, a late onset trigger (stimulus already playing) gives a shorter interval and a negative offset: positive rho. Flagged trials and |offset| > 100 ms excluded.

latency_trf.method: forward TRF envelope -> good gradiometers, 128 Hz, 1-10 Hz, lags -200..600 ms, ridge alpha 1, all 11 trials; GFP per subject, mean over subjects; M50 = highest local GFP max 30-80 ms, M100 = 80-160 ms; rel_latency = shift of the subject GFP vs the leave-one-out grand GFP (0-300 ms, +-62 ms, parabolic; positive = later)

sanity.note: computed on the stored data at 64 Hz, all 160 MEG channels (157 mag incl. bads + 3 ref_meg); flat = channel std < 1e-3 x median std over all of them; ref_meg has no unit range in the repo check

gwilliams2023.note: repo validator, KIT 208 axial gradiometers (mag, bads not excluded), audio-derived features (Hilbert envelope for low; half-wave-rectified waveform for mlr), audio-based onsets, 20-subject pilot

karunathilake2023_aging.note: 6 DSS components (UMD KIT system, same lab family), 1-10 Hz from the authors, quiet condition; backward model same method (64 Hz, lags 0-250 ms, lambda 0.1); latency TRF same settings (128 Hz, 1-10 Hz, -200..600 ms) but over DSS components

repo_validator_cli.command: cd /home/gu08wuvu/cnsp_datasets_batch2 && python -m cnsp_datasets.validate brodbeck2022 --standardised-dir <standardised> --first-attended --picks mag --n-subjects 0 --tiers low,mlr --json <json> --fig-dir <dir>
repo_validator_cli.note: --picks mag keeps the bad channels (raw.pick('mag') does not exclude bads); mlr is absent from its output because stimulus_feature(.., 'hf') returns None for envelopes

pass_criteria: low: backward population p_circ and p_mismatch < 0.05, lag-sweep peak within 1 sample (15.6 ms) of 0 (repo forward low tier must also pass); mlr: repo SNR (18-45 ms vs -75..-20 ms) population p < 0.05 against 100 circular-shift nulls; tiers cumulative
validation_tier_basis: raw (standardised data as stored); refreg reported alongside
